subject: Hosted API: proposal to increase monthly commit + new rate band
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Ng <claire@acmetech.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API: proposal to increase monthly commit + new rate band

Hi Claire —

Great speaking yesterday. Per our conversation, Acme is seeing the expected production ramp on search summarization and intent classification. Based on the usage curve you shared, we recommend two changes to keep latency predictable and reduce per-token cost as volume grows:

1) Monthly commit increase: move from 1.2B tokens/month to 3.5B tokens/month (effective 2027-11-01).
2) Introduce a new mid-tier rate band for 2.5B+ tokens that reduces per-1k token price by ~18% compared to your current band.

Operational notes:
- We’ll reserve dedicated hosted capacity to keep p95 generation latency under 300ms for typical 256-token responses.
- A one-time transition credit of $12,500 to offset overage risk during the first 30 days.
- No change to data residency or retention defaults.

I attached a draft amendment (Commit_Amendment_v1.pdf) and a short projection workbook. If this looks reasonable, I can loop in billing and legal to produce a final amendment and a DocuSign envelope.

Next steps we propose:
- Confirm target commit and effective date (Claire) — due by Tue 10/04
- Finalize amendment (Redwood legal) — target 10/08
- Sign & enable new capacity (both teams) — target 11/01

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk the numbers.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: Commit_Amendment_v1.pdf (pdf), rate_band_projection_Q4.xlsx (xlsx)

Cc: procurement <payments@acmetech.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: proposal to increase monthly commit + new rate band

Thanks Aditya — this aligns with what we discussed. A couple of quick clarifying questions before we route to procurement: 

- Can you confirm the billing cadence for the commit increase (monthly invoice or pro-rated first month)?
- Is the transition credit applied against the first invoice or issued as a separate credit note?
- Any SLA change or credit if latency slips during high traffic windows?

Procurement (payments@acmetech.com) — please advise on Acme’s standard PO timing once we have the amendment.

—Claire

Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API: proposal to increase monthly commit + new rate band

Looping you in for pricing + contract ops. Claire at Acme wants confirmation on a couple of billing/SLA items before procurement moves. Key asks below and my suggested responses.

Claire’s asks:
- Billing cadence? -> Suggest monthly invoices, with pro-rated first month for effective date mid-cycle.
- How is transition credit applied? -> Suggest credit against first invoice; we can also provide a credit note if procurement prefers that format.
- SLA change? -> No change to base SLA; propose an SLO addendum: 99.5% availability and a 10% service credit for monthly p95 latency regressions over agreed threshold during organic spikes.

Proposed commercial changes (high-level):
- New commit: 3.5B tokens/month (12-month term)
- Effective: 2027-11-01 (pro-rate Oct)
- Pricing: tiered effective per-1k token price: base band up to 1.2B (unchanged), mid band 1.2B-2.5B (5% discount), new upper band 2.5B+ (18% discount vs current)
- Transition credit: $12,500 applied to first invoice

Laura — can you confirm this structure is acceptable from finance and whether we should offer a prepay option for an additional 3% discount? Priyom — can you prepare a short amendment that includes the SLO addendum language and the credit mechanics? Hannah — heads up on ops to reserve capacity and run a canary traffic test during the first week after go-live.

Thanks,
Aditya

Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API: proposal to increase monthly commit + new rate band

Aditya — fine from finance to proceed with the structure as proposed. A few notes: 

- Apply transition credit as a credit on the first invoice; procurement commonly requires a credit note so include both (credit line + PDF credit note).
- Prepay option: ok to offer 3% additional discount if Acme pre-pays at least 6 months. Document the payment terms in the amendment.
- Deal registration: mark as "Commit Expansion Q4" and assign ACV to quarterly targets — PR will upload to the forecast.

Priyom — please produce the amendment with:
- Term: 12 months starting 2027-11-01
- Pricing bands and per-1k values (use the projection workbook for numbers)
- Credit mechanics and credit note template
- SLO addendum language (99.5% availability / p95 latency credit)

I can sign off once I review the amendment draft. Aditya — get me the final HubSpot entry and the proposed DocuSign URL when ready.

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai

Summary of final items: 
- Term: 12 months starting 2027-11-01 (pro-rated Oct invoice)
- Commit: 3.5B tokens/month
- Rate bands: preserved lower band, 1.2B-2.5B (5% off), 2.5B+ (18% off)
- Transition credit: $12,500 applied to first invoice (credit note attached)
- SLA addendum: 99.5% availability, p95 latency credit mechanics included

Please complete the DocuSign by EOD 10/08 so we can provision capacity and schedule the canary. I’ll coordinate the provisioning window with Hannah and your engineering lead once signed.
